records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 (2026-08-26) but nothing since; no invite sent, no tickets. Customer replied politely but passively ([email:63b51531]: "Will reach out if anything comes up") after two nudges ([email:43289cfb], [email:b4ca7cea]), suggesting low urgency. Pro plan and an engaged admin leave some chance within the 8 days.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for the quick note -- glad the first project is feeling good so far.

One thing that tends to help at this stage: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks to that project is usually the fastest way to see how it fits your work. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to hop on a short call this week and look at your project together, or I can answer by email -- whichever is easier.

Best,
Chidi
